tasks.title: Promote staged users migration into the live migrations tree

tasks.title: Implement the account-linking-by-verified-email invariant as a pure function
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm: same verified email under two methods resolves to one existing account; a payload with no verified email is rejected before any persistence call

tasks.title: Build the Drizzle repository for the users shadow table
tasks.dod: integration tests confirm findByEmail, findById and upsert-by-id against the live users table, including the UNIQUE(email) conflict path

tasks.title: Wire the Clerk SDK client and Svix webhook-signature verification helper
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm a validly-signed Svix payload verifies and a tampered one is rejected; Clerk client reads config from env with no secret committed

tasks.title: Implement the Clerk webhook route handler (POST /webhooks/clerk)
tasks.dod: handler returns 200 with the upserted User on a verified user.created/user.updated event, 401 auth.webhook_invalid_signature on bad Svix signature, 422 auth.email_required when no verified email is present, and redelivery with the same svix-id is deduped

tasks.title: Build the session-read helper with the synchronous create-or-fetch fallback
tasks.dod: unit/integration tests confirm: a valid Clerk session resolves to the local user row, creating it on the spot if the webhook hasn't landed yet (sad.md §11 risk mitigation); no session or an expired/invalid one resolves to a typed unauthenticated result with no data leaked

tasks.title: Implement the dashboard route handler (GET /api/v1/dashboard)
tasks.dod: handler returns 200 DashboardData with has_trips:false for a valid session, and 401 auth.session_invalid with details.return_to set to the originally requested path when unauthenticated

tasks.title: Implement the logout route handler (POST /api/v1/auth/logout)
tasks.dod: handler revokes the session server-side via the Clerk SDK and returns 204; a subsequent dashboard request on the same browser returns 401; a request with no active session returns 401 auth.session_invalid

tasks.title: Add return-to origin validation and the unauthenticated-dashboard redirect path
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm a return-to URL sharing this app's scheme/host/port is preserved and round-tripped after login, and any off-origin return-to value is discarded in favor of the default dashboard destination

tasks.title: Build the i18n message catalog and translate() helper
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm translate(key) resolves from en.json for a supported Accept-Language and falls back to English for an unsupported one

tasks.title: Build the new shared UI primitives (OAuthProviderButton, EmailInput, Button, LinkButton, Alert, Spinner, Header, EmptyState)
tasks.dod: each primitive has a component test for its documented states (incl. loading variants) and is registered in docs/design-system.md

tasks.title: Build SCR-01 Login screen, all 5 states
tasks.dod: component tests cover default, loading, error-sign-in-failed, error-email-required and redirected-sign-in-required exactly as screens.md SCR-01 specifies

tasks.title: Build SCR-02 Check your email screen, all 4 states
tasks.dod: component tests cover default, loading, resent-confirmation and error-rate-limited exactly as screens.md SCR-02 specifies

tasks.title: Build SCR-04 Magic-link invalid screen, all 3 states
tasks.dod: component tests cover default, loading and error-rate-limited exactly as screens.md SCR-04 specifies

tasks.title: Build SCR-03 Dashboard shell screen, both states, wired to the dashboard and logout handlers
tasks.dod: component tests cover loading and default/empty exactly as screens.md SCR-03 specifies; the header logout button calls the T8 logout handler and redirects to login

tasks.title: Write integration tests for the QG-1 security scenarios
tasks.dod: integration tests assert (a) two sign-ins with the same verified email via different methods resolve to one account, (b) a dashboard request after logout on the same session is denied, (c) an off-origin return-to param is rejected

tasks.title: Write e2e tests for the sign-up-to-dashboard and return-to happy paths
tasks.dod: Playwright e2e covers: sign-up reaches the dashboard, an unauthenticated dashboard visit redirects to login and returns to the originally requested page after sign-in, a fresh account sees the empty-state dashboard, and the shell falls back to English for an unsupported browser locale

tasks.title: Fix the open redirect at /login and the tautological QG-1 test that hid it
tasks.dod: an off-origin return_to on GET /login resolves to /dashboard before it ever reaches Clerk (validated in LoginPage, not only in middleware); the QG-1 test drives an untrusted return_to through the LoginPage/LoginContainer render path (not only the pure resolveReturnTo helper) and fails without the fix

tasks.title: Add the /sso-callback route completing OAuth and magic-link sign-in
tasks.dod: the provider/magic-link return trip lands on /sso-callback, which mounts Clerk's AuthenticateWithRedirectCallback and redirects to the validated return-to (or /dashboard) on success, instead of 404ing

tasks.title: Add the /check-email route mounting CheckEmailScreen with resend wiring
tasks.dod: GET /check-email?email=... renders CheckEmailScreen with a container wiring onResend to Clerk's resend call, reachable from LoginContainer's magic-link branch

tasks.title: Render SCR-04 magic-link-invalid on an expired/used/failed callback
tasks.dod: the /sso-callback handler renders MagicLinkInvalidScreen when Clerk's email-link verification reports expired/used/failed, and the branch is covered by a test

tasks.title: Wire AC-01b's sign-in-failed error surfacing from the callback
tasks.dod: a failed or declined OAuth callback redirects to /login?error=sign_in_failed, and a test drives that callback outcome into the rendered login screen's error-sign-in-failed state

tasks.title: Surface AC-03b's email-required error to the Traveler on the interactive path
tasks.dod: getSessionUser returns a distinct result for the no-verified-email case (not a bare unauthenticated), the login route redirects to /login?error=email_required on it, and a test asserts the rendered login screen shows the email-required alert

tasks.title: Add AC-03's "signed in to existing account" state to SCR-03
tasks.dod: screens.md documents the SCR-03 linked-account state, DashboardScreen renders it when the session resolved to a pre-existing row matched by email, and a component test asserts the message

tasks.title: Wire the remaining i18n catalog keys through translate() across all screens
tasks.dod: every user-visible string in LoginScreen, CheckEmailScreen, MagicLinkInvalidScreen, Header and DashboardScreen resolves via translate() from en.json (no hardcoded literals), and dashboard.emptyState matches the shipped copy

tasks.title: Implement svix-id webhook dedupe
tasks.dod: the webhook handler persists processed svix-ids and short-circuits a redelivery with the same id to a single upsert; the existing test is corrected to assert exactly one upsert on redelivery

tasks.title: Add a distinct error code for the webhook email-conflict branch
tasks.dod: the email-already-linked-to-a-different-account case returns a new auth.email_conflict code (not the reused auth.email_required), documented in contracts/openapi.yaml and covered by a test

tasks.title: Thread the real requested path through getDashboard's 401 and DashboardContainer
tasks.dod: getDashboard's 401 details.return_to carries the actually-requested path (not a hardcoded constant), DashboardContainer forwards it into the /login redirect, and a .catch branch handles a failed fetch instead of spinning forever

tasks.title: Guard the Clerk webhook handler against non-user event types
tasks.dod: the handler branches on event.type, 200-and-ignores non-user.created/user.updated events, guards Array.isArray(email_addresses) and a nullable verification entry, and the route wraps the handler body in a try/catch mapping unexpected throws to a 500 in the error envelope

tasks.title: Introduce AppError and the unified {error:{code,message}} envelope at every route boundary
tasks.dod: an AppError base class exists, every API/webhook route maps thrown AppErrors to {error:{code,message}} at its boundary (per CLAUDE.md), and contracts/openapi.yaml's Error schema matches

tasks.title: Make the Postgres client a memoized singleton with env validation
tasks.dod: src/db/client.ts allocates one module-level pool reused across requests instead of one per call, and throws fast if DATABASE_URL is unset instead of building a broken client

tasks.title: Add a magic-link sign-up fallback for a first-time email
tasks.dod: when signIn.create rejects with form_identifier_not_found, LoginContainer falls back to useSignUp() for the magic-link strategy instead of showing the generic sign-in-failed error

tasks.title: Replace hand-rolled Svix verification with the Clerk SDK's verifyWebhook helper
tasks.dod: the webhook route uses @clerk/nextjs/webhooks' verifyWebhook(request, {signingSecret}) instead of the hand-rolled svix wrapper, keeping an injectable verify seam for tests; the direct svix dependency is dropped if no longer used

tasks.title: Move return-to origin validation into the auth module
tasks.dod: resolveReturnTo moves from src/modules/dashboard/app/ to src/modules/auth/app/, taking the default destination as a parameter; src/middleware.ts and every caller import it from its new home

tasks.title: Fix the users migration slot reuse and add the missing db:down runner
tasks.dod: the live migrations tree no longer overwrites an already-applied slot 0 in place (the reset is either reverted to an appended migration or explicitly documented as an intentional reset), and scripts/migrate-down.ts exists so pnpm db:down runs

tasks.title: Register Alert's success variant in the design system inventory
tasks.dod: docs/design-system.md lists Alert's success variant alongside info/error, and the screens.md "New components" registration column reflects the components actually registered

tasks.title: Replace the skipped e2e stubs with real coverage for the sign-in and return-to paths
tasks.dod: e2e/auth-dashboard.spec.ts scenarios have real bodies (not empty test.skip) asserting the sign-up-to-dashboard path, the unauthenticated-dashboard return-to round trip, the fresh-account empty state, and the locale fallback; any scenario still blocked by the lack of a live Clerk instance in this environment is skipped with a named reason, never silently, and CI is not claiming coverage it doesn't have

tasks.title: Use Clerk's email-link verification API for magic-link completion, not the OAuth callback handler
tasks.dod: SsoCallbackContainer calls clerk.handleEmailLinkVerification (not handleRedirectCallback) on the email-link path, branching from the OAuth path on the presence of email-link query params; invalidity is detected via isEmailLinkError/EmailLinkErrorCodeStatus from @clerk/shared, not invented error-code strings; onVerifiedOnOtherDevice satisfies AC-02b's different-device case; test asserts against the real Clerk error shape, not a hand-authored one

tasks.title: Close the path-traversal bypass in resolveLoginReturnTo (/..//host still resolves off-origin)
tasks.dod: resolveLoginReturnTo rejects any resolved pathname that doesn't start with a single '/' (no leading '//' or backslash), falling back to the default dashboard path; return-to.test.ts covers /..//evil.example, //evil.example, /a/../..//evil.example; qg1-security.test.ts drives the untrusted value through LoginPage/SsoCallbackPage's actual render path (not only the pure helper) and fails without the fix

tasks.title: Verify the webhook signature before consulting the dedupe cache
tasks.dod: clerk-webhook.ts checks svix signature verification before any dedupeStore lookup, so an unsigned POST can never read a cached user's id/email; cached value carries no PII (a status marker only); the process-lifetime Map is bounded (TTL or size cap); test proves an unsigned replayed svix-id is rejected, not served from cache

tasks.title: Persist the second identity on account-linking so the 'linked' banner clears after first render
tasks.dod: a second Clerk identity that links by email gets its own local row (or an equivalent marker) so a repeat getSessionUser(userId) call finds it locally without a Clerk API round-trip and returns linked:false; session.test.ts calls getSessionUser twice with the same linked userId and asserts linked is true then false, with only one Clerk fetch total

tasks.title: Wire SCR-04's i18n strings and add the missing dashboard.errorFetchFailed catalog key
tasks.dod: sso-callback/page.tsx resolves magicLinkInvalid.* via translateAll and passes strings into MagicLinkInvalidScreen; dashboard.errorFetchFailed is added to en.json and to dashboard/page.tsx's stringKeys; a test asserts every en.json key is referenced by at least one page's stringKeys

tasks.title: Add the linked field and the webhook's ignored-event response to openapi.yaml
tasks.dod: contracts/openapi.yaml's DashboardData gains linked:boolean; the webhook's 200 response documents the ignored-event body (a distinct schema or a 204) alongside the User body; both 401 error codes (auth.session_invalid, auth.email_required) are listed on GET /api/v1/dashboard

tasks.title: Handle the logout response instead of always redirecting to /login
tasks.dod: DashboardContainer's handleLogout branches on the response status (204 -> redirect; otherwise -> error state), wraps the fetch in try/catch, and a failing-logout test proves the Traveler is not told they're signed out while the Clerk session is still live

tasks.title: Fix db:down to actually remove the migration's journal row
tasks.dod: migrate-down.ts targets drizzle's real journal table/schema and the SQL-hash key drizzle actually writes (not a guessed table/tag), so it no longer silently no-ops; a round-trip test (up -> down -> up) proves the users table is restored, run against pglite or a real Postgres instance

tasks.title: Give the email-conflict session case its own error code instead of auth.session_invalid
tasks.dod: getSessionUser returns {authenticated:false, reason:'email_conflict'} when upsertById reports email_conflict during the create-or-fetch fallback; get-dashboard.ts maps it to auth.email_conflict (not auth.session_invalid), the login screen shows the email-conflict copy instead of silently redirect-looping; session.test.ts covers the conflict case

tasks.title: Wire Clerk's testing-token harness so e2e scenario 3 can actually complete a magic link

tasks.title: Fix CheckEmailContainer's resend: preserve return_to, add sign-up fallback, stop mislabeling every failure as rate-limited
tasks.dod: resend includes ?return_to= the way the initial send does; a form_identifier_not_found rejection falls back to useSignUp the same way LoginContainer does; only a genuine 429/too_many_requests renders error-rate-limited, other failures render a distinct/generic error; CheckEmailContainer.test.tsx covers all three cases

tasks.title: Make SCR-04's 'send new link' actually resend, and reach its loading/rate-limited states
tasks.dod: onSendNewLink re-issues the email-link request (carrying the known email and returnTo) instead of navigating to /login; SsoCallbackContainer drives state to loading during the request and error-rate-limited on a 429, both reachable in a test

tasks.title: Key the memoized DB client by connection string

tasks.title: Add SCR-03's fetch-failure error state to screens.md

tasks.title: Verify Clerk middleware coverage for /sso-callback and /check-email

tasks.title: Fix openapi.yaml and screens.md drift found in review round 3
tasks.dod: openapi.yaml's dashboard 401 documents auth.email_conflict with an example; the dashboard 200 example includes the linked field; ClerkWebhookEvent's type enum no longer contradicts the ignored-event example; screens.md adds SCR-01's error-email-conflict row and SCR-02's error-sign-in-failed row

tasks.title: Give SCR-04's resend a sign-up fallback and a visible failure state

tasks.title: Give a failed logout its own error message instead of the dashboard-fetch-failed copy
tasks.dod: a 401/500 from the logout endpoint renders a distinct dashboard.errorLogoutFailed message, not errorFetchFailed; existing DashboardContainer tests are updated to assert the correct copy

tasks.title: Make the migrate-down test exercise the real script instead of reimplementing its SQL
tasks.dod: tests/integration/migrations/migrate-down.test.ts calls an exported revert step from scripts/migrate-down.ts rather than inlining the DELETE statement; reverting migrate-down.ts's table/key breaks this test

tasks.title: Actually deliver AC-02b's outcome for cross-device magic-link verification
tasks.dod: opening a magic link on a different device than the one that requested it signs the user in and shows the dashboard on that device; onVerifiedOnOtherDevice and ClientMismatch each render a state distinct from the generic 'link no longer valid' error and neither offers a 'send new link' CTA that would supersede the session just established elsewhere; screens.md documents the new state(s); test asserts a session is actually established (or, for ClientMismatch, that no destructive resend is offered), not just that a particular screen renders

tasks.title: Stop the logout retry loop when signOut() rejects after the server already revoked the session
tasks.dod: when the server returns 204 but the client-side clerk.signOut() call rejects, the app does not show a retryable 'couldn't sign you out, try again' state that can never succeed (the server session is already gone, so a retried logout 401s); instead it treats the server-confirmed revoke as authoritative (e.g. redirect to /login so the middleware bounces the stale client token) or retries signOut() itself rather than re-POSTing logout; test covers the 204-resolves-but-signOut-rejects case

tasks.title: Re-validate or invalidate persisted linked-identity mappings instead of trusting them forever
tasks.dod: a persisted identity→user mapping in linked_identities is not trusted indefinitely once the underlying Clerk identity's email changes; either the mapping is re-validated against Clerk before use, or it is kept in sync via the user.updated webhook (update/delete path), so a stale mapping cannot permanently attribute one person's identity to another user's account; test covers an identity whose email changed after linking
